data.text: This guide demonstrates how to use the integrated File Viewer with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) for document analysis and chat functionality.

items: Open any chat conversation
Click the **Documents** button in the chat header
Upload documents using the **Upload Documents** button
Select a document from the list to preview it
Use **Document Actions** for quick analysis

data.text: The system supports multiple file formats with intelligent processing:
The File Viewer provides comprehensive document interaction capabilities:

items: **PDF Viewer**: Native PDF.js integration with zoom, search, and navigation
**Text Preview**: Formatted text with syntax highlighting for code files
**Image Preview**: Support for common image formats (PNG, JPG, GIF)
**Table Preview**: Interactive tables for CSV and spreadsheet data
**Markdown Rendering**: Live preview of Markdown documents

data.text: Quick access buttons for AI-powered document analysis:

items: 🔍 **Summary**: Generate comprehensive document overview
📌 **Key Points**: Extract bullet-pointed main findings
📚 **References**: Identify citations, sources, and external links
💡 **Insights**: Provide analysis and implications
✨ **Highlight**: Mark important passages and quotes
❓ **Ask**: Guided prompts for specific questions
📈 **Expand**: Detailed analysis with follow-up suggestions

data.text: Once documents are uploaded, you can chat about them naturally:

data.code:
Example Chat Interactions:

🗣️ User: "What are the main findings in the AI research paper?"
🤖 Bot: [Analyzes uploaded PDF and provides summary with citations]

🗣️ User: "Compare the methodologies across all uploaded papers"
🤖 Bot: [Cross-references multiple documents and provides comparison]

🗣️ User: "Extract all performance metrics from Table 3"
🤖 Bot: [Locates specific table and extracts data with context]

data.text: The File Viewer integrates seamlessly with the RAG pipeline, providing both visual document interaction and intelligent content analysis in a unified interface.
data.caption: System Architecture

items: **File Organization**: Use descriptive filenames for better document identification
**Upload Strategy**: Upload related documents to the same chat for cross-analysis
**Question Formulation**: Be specific in your questions for more accurate responses
**Document Quality**: Ensure documents are text-searchable (not scanned images)
**Follow-up Queries**: Build on previous questions to dive deeper into topics
